// Only loader/configuration modules are exercised. No browser or typesetting.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const bundle = fs.readFileSync('internal/webui/static/vendor/tex-svg.js', 'utf8');
const marker = 'var __webpack_exports__={};';
if (bundle.split(marker).length !== 2) throw Error('unexpected bundle format');
const instrumented = bundle.replace(marker,
  'globalThis.redRequire=__webpack_require__;globalThis.redModules=__webpack_modules__;return;' + marker);
const c = {
  document: {currentScript: {src: 'http://fixture.invalid/static/vendor/tex-svg.js'}},
  MathJax: {tex: {inlineMath: [['$', '$']]}, svg: {fontCache: 'global'}},
  console,
};
vm.runInNewContext(instrumented, c);
const loader = c.redRequire(235);
const candidates = Object.entries(c.redModules).filter(([_, f]) => {
  const text = f.toString();
  return text.includes('color') && text.includes('autoload');
});
console.log(JSON.stringify({version: c.redRequire(3282).VERSION,
  configurationModules: candidates.map(([id]) => id)}));
for (const name of ['color', 'physics']) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({extension: name,
    url: loader.Package.resolvePath('[mathjax]/input/tex/extensions/' + name)}));
}
for (const [id] of candidates) {
  try {
    const mod = c.redRequire(Number(id));
    const config = mod.AutoloadConfiguration || mod.RequireConfiguration;
    console.log(JSON.stringify({module: id, exports: Object.keys(mod),
      configuration: config && {name: config.name, options: config.options}}));
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({module: id, error: String(e)}));
  }
}
